exposure: Proportion of Black women giving birth at the hospital
Proportion of Black women giving birth at the hospital (low to high)
cohort: 65,524 Black and 251,426 White women at low risk for cesarean who gave birth at one of 493 hospitals across four states in the US
finding: Black women had higher odds of a low-risk cesarean than White women and were more likely to access care in hospitals with higher low-risk cesarean rates.
mod_finding: Black women had higher odds of a low-risk cesarean birth than White women.
